technique_name: Describe the characteristics of the main character.
description: Katniss Everdeen is the protagonist of The Hunger Games. She is a brave, resilient, and resourceful 16-year-old who is willing to do what it takes to survive. Despite her youth, she is strong and determined, possessing both physical and mental strength. Katniss also has a strong moral compass, refusing to take part in some of the more extreme acts of the Games.
